description: Features from the monthly balances of earlier point-of-sale and cash loans with Home Credit, one row per applicant. Built in notebooks/09_pos_cash_eda_features.ipynb.

POS_MONTHS_SINCE_LATEST_ROW.definition: Months from the latest row of any loan to the application.

POS_MAX_DPD_RAW.definition: The largest days past due without the tolerance rule (SK_DPD).

POS_N_LOANS_ARREARS.definition: Loans ever in arrears under the tolerance rule.

POS_MONTHS_ARREARS_12M.definition: Months in arrears in the last 12.

POS_MONTHS_SINCE_ARREARS.definition: Months since the latest month in arrears. Missing if never in arrears.

POS_N_ARREARS_AT_APPLICATION.definition: Running loans in arrears in their latest row. A loan is running if its latest row is Active and no more than 3 months before the application.

POS_N_RETURNED.definition: Loans ever in status Returned to the store.

POS_SHARE_FINISHED_EARLY.definition: Share of completed loans that ran for under three quarters of their first term on record.

POS_SHARE_TERM_CHANGED.definition: Share of loans whose term changed.

POS_MAX_SHARE_LEFT.definition: The largest share of its term still to pay, on any running loan.
POS_MAX_SHARE_LEFT.warning: Differs between train and test (stage 8, rule 1): keep with a warning: test applicants are further through their running loans, while the column is filled in equally often in both files.

POS_N_PAST_TERM.definition: Running loans with no instalments left: past their last scheduled instalment and not yet closed.

POS_N_LOANS.definition: Loans with monthly rows. 0 when there are none.

POS_N_MONTHS.definition: Months on record, over all loans.

POS_MONTHS_BACK.definition: How far back the record goes, in months.

POS_SHARE_MONTHS_ARREARS.definition: Share of months with days past due under the tolerance rule (SK_DPD_DEF above 0).

POS_MAX_DPD.definition: The largest days past due under the tolerance rule.

POS_N_CALLED_IN.definition: Loans ever in status Demand or Amortized debt.

POS_INSTALMENTS_LEFT.definition: Instalments still to pay on running loans, in total.

POS_MAX_INSTALMENTS_LEFT.definition: The most instalments still to pay on any one running loan.

POS_MONTHS_SINCE_LAST_START.definition: Months since the most recent loan's first row.

rules: Arrears are measured with SK_DPD_DEF, which ignores small debts; SK_DPD also counts small balances left after a loan ended.
A loan's state at the application is its latest row; month -1 exists for only some loans (stage 4).
properties_verified: Each applicant's features depend on that applicant's rows only (7.4).
An independent rebuild of 500 applicants agrees on all 21 features (7.2).
No row is dated on or after the application (stage 1); month 0 does not exist.
The table passes the train-test supply test (1.4, 3.4).
selection_note: Two features were dropped using development outcomes (rule 3). The holdout was not used.
expectation: Stage 8 expects a gain at or below the noise floor when these are added to the model of notebook 08.
